def collect_items(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        text = " ".join(
            str(value.get(key, ""))
            for key in ("status", "message", "type", "reason", "description")
        ).lower()
        if any(term in text for term in ("below threshold", "low stock", "near expiration", "expiring")):
            items_to_replenish.append(value)
